title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study J)
description: Study J of the bigP3BCI collection, which provides EEG recordings from 20 healthy participants using a 9x8 character grid P300 speller with a performance-based row-column paradigm. Data were acquired with 16 EEG channels at 256 Hz and annotated with target and non-target events using HED tags. The dataset supports machine learning and benchmarking of P300-based brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 16 channels with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier at 256 Hz, using a standard 10-20 montage. Participants completed one session in a laboratory with a visual P300 speller, calibration followed by online testing with feedback. Target and non-target stimuli were epoched over a 0-1.0 s interval.
